# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Deno joins Cloudflare and sets transition timelines for its products](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/01-deno-cloudflare-transition.html) — The team sets a year of runtime updates and six more months for Deploy, while directing future work toward Workers and Durable Objects.
- [Ai2 allocates GPU time through budgets and reports shorter queues](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/02-ai2-gpu-time-budgets.html) — An internal report distinguishes hardware occupancy, team allocations and useful computation, with results tied to its own deployment.
- [NASA uses a departing cargo spacecraft to test twelve heat-shield capsules](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/03-krepe-heat-shield-tests.html) — KREPE-3 examines materials and shapes during reentry; the announcement describes an experiment rather than certified shields for future crews.
- [NASA opens proposals for commercial low-Earth-orbit stations](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/04-commercial-stations-proposals.html) — Proposals are due December 8, with awards expected in spring 2027; opening the solicitation does not establish that new stations are ready.
- [Living Planet Index again reports a 73% decline: what the measure actually means](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/05-living-planet-index-2026.html) — Our World in Data explains the 1970–2022 data and why the index is not a count of animals or species lost.
- [Falcon ASR targets Arabic dialects with word-level timestamps](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-09/01-falcon-arabic-asr.html) — TII reports Arabic and English evaluation results, with comparisons tied to specific datasets and a dated leaderboard snapshot.
- [SSPICY prepares to inspect inactive orbital objects without docking](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-09/02-sspicy-orbital-inspection.html) — Otter has launched, while NASA places target approaches in early 2027.
- [Statisticians argue AI time horizons need task-difficulty diagnostics](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-09/03-metr-time-horizon-statistics.html) — A new preprint reanalyzes METR data and explains why equal time multipliers need not represent equal capability gains.
- [Hugging Face reports small-model training with ML Intern, checks and budgets](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-09/04-ml-intern-training-cases.html) — A six-project account includes baselines, short trial runs and compute charges, rather than a universal price list.
- [Study of 50 card packs finds limited disclosure of rare-card odds](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-09/05-trading-card-odds.html) — Only one fifth of the Hong Kong sample disclosed any probabilities; the study assesses information, rather than whether pack contents are fair.
- [Haiku 5.5 targets high-volume work with separate long-prompt pricing](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/01-haiku-55-volume-work.html) — Anthropic has released a new small model, with economics that depend on prompt length and the work being completed.
- [New Surface devices promise larger local models as preorders open](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/02-surface-local-ai-preorders.html) — Laptop Ultra and RTX Spark Dev Box offer up to 128 GB of unified memory, with performance claims that need careful reading.
- [Windows Search adds actions in an English-language experimental preview](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/03-windows-search-preview-actions.html) — Microsoft is testing a WinUI 3 search experience with a single results list and a staged feature roadmap.
- [Dragon targets an October 13 launch with science cargo and solar arrays](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/04-dragon-crs35-science-plan.html) — NASA has outlined CRS-35, with docking and experimental results still ahead.
- [MIT reports Margaret Hamilton's death, recalling her software-engineering legacy](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/05-margaret-hamilton-engineering-legacy.html) — The Apollo software leader died on September 30; MIT published its obituary on October 7.
- [Google introduces Gemini agent as a work system with memory and spending controls](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/06-gemini-enterprise-agent.html) — The Gemini at Work announcement connects models, enterprise tools and execution, with claims to assess against real workflows.
- [LISA moves toward flight hardware with a final test telescope](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/07-lisa-test-telescope.html) — NASA has announced a new optical engineering stage for the gravitational-wave observatory planned for the mid-2030s.
- [Solar Orbiter traces a solar-wind magnetic switchback to its source](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/08-solar-orbiter-switchback.html) — Particle composition links the bend to an opening magnetic loop, with waves and turbulence shaping its subsequent journey.
- [Anne Carson wins the literature Nobel for work across classical and contemporary forms](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/09-anne-carson-nobel.html) — The Swedish Academy honored the Canadian writer whose books cross poetry, translation, essays and visual art.
- [Crew-12 splashes down off California after 237 days on the ISS](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-08/10-crew12-splashdown.html) — NASA confirmed the four-person crew's return, while its first report described Dragon recovery as still in progress.
